title: v0.19.3 — Tool Error Feedback & Agent Loop Improvements
description:
## Goal

Fix q's tool error feedback loop so LLMs can self-correct on tool-call failures. Live benchmark testing (7 workflow tasks, glm-5.1) scored 50.4/100 — not because the model is incapable, but because q swallows validation error details and returns generic messages that don't guide the LLM.

## Source
REVIEW-v0.19.2-LIVE-WORKFLOW-BENCHMARK.md

## Architecture Decisions
- AD1: Error messages must include schema hints (missing param name + type + usage)
- AD2: Auto-retry must classify error permanence (skip retry on tool validation failures)
- AD3: Project file tree in initial context (depth-2, first turn only)
- AD4: Benchmark-mode selective tool registration (exclude meta-tools)

## Expected Outcome
- Average score: 50.4 → 70+
- PASS rate: 14% → 57-71%
- Avg iterations: 8.7 → 5-6
